summary: Rapports hub (Comptabilité) tested end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 hub-specific tests pass (test_reports_hub.py) — GET /api/acct/report/pnl-monthly?year=2026 returns 12 months + total on non-header lines and no total on headers; CRUD /api/acct/budget-managers admin-only (POST/PUT/DELETE => 403 for editor/user, 200 for admin); GET /api/acct/report/by-manager filters lines to the manager's accounts only (verified line accounts subset). Frontend: hub loads at Comptabilité > Rapports with 5 type buttons (bilan, pnl, cashflow, monthly, manager) — data-testid=`acct-reports-type-manager` (NOT 'by-manager' as noted in request). PnlMonthlyView shows 15 cols (Compte, Description, JAN..DÉC, TOTAL) and 443 rows; PROJETS/SERVICE header rows have empty amount cells (verified). ByManagerView allows admin to open Manage dialog, create a manager (TEST_UI_Resp, 2 accounts), it appears in the select as 'TEST_UI_Resp (2 cptes)'. Regression: Bilan, État des résultats and Flux de trésorerie all render without errors when switched via the hub type bar. Test manager cleaned from DB.
critical_code_review_comments: Data-testid for 'Par responsable budgétaire' is `acct-reports-type-manager` (value='manager') — the review_request called it 'by-manager'. Not a bug, but worth aligning docs.
server.py is ~3932 lines — as noted in prior iterations, split Comptabilité endpoints into a dedicated module.
list_budget_managers uses str(d['_id']) rather than excluding _id — handled correctly, no ObjectId leak.

In ByManagerView (Comptabilite.js), when period changes to a locked/older period with no manager selected, no fallback message; UI already covered by 'Sélectionnez un responsable' placeholder — acceptable.

seed_data_creation: Test users editor.test and user.test may have been created if missing (idempotent). Test budget manager TEST_UI_Resp was created via UI then deleted via API cleanup. Final state: acct_budget_managers collection empty.

Monthly view has 12 month columns + TOTAL; headers rows (kind='header') correctly omit the total field. To test by-manager UI selection, use `page.select_option('[data-testid=acct-bymanager-select]', <mgr_id>)` — the option value is the manager id, not the name.
